rt:model.rt:sub:
Sub GetNodeStatus() Dim WS_ID As String Dim NStatus As UShort Dim NDStatus As UShort Dim NodeNet As UShort Dim IP1 As String Dim IP2 As String Dim CPU_load As UShort Dim LocalNDID As UInt
If NdID == Nothing Then t_ID.text = "" rect_ID.fill = Col_Ar(7) t_Status.text = "" rect_Status.fill = Col_Ar(7) t_Net_1.text = "" t_Net_2.text = "" rect_Net_1.fill = Col_Ar(7) rect_Net_2.fill = Col_Ar(7) t_CPU.text = "" rect_CPU.fill = Col_Ar(7) t_DataOK.text = "" rect_DataOK.fill = Col_Ar(7) t_Repl_S.text = "" rect_Repl_S.fill = Col_Ar(7) t_Repl_R.text = "" rect_Repl_R.fill = Col_Ar(7) t_Vis.text = "" rect_Vis.fill = Col_Ar(7)
Else NdID.Refresh() WS_ID = NdID.NodeName NStatus = NdID.NodeStatus IP1 = NdID.IPAddress IP2 = NdID.IPAddress_2 LocalNDID = RTA.LocalNode.NodeId If NdID.NodeId == LocalNDID Then NodeNet = LocalNetMask & 0xC 'берём только старшие биты Else NodeNet = NdID.NetMask & 0xC 'далее, если своя сеть есть (старшие биты), то младшие биты по И переносим в старшие 'это позволит быстрее определять отказы т.к. старшие биты обсчитываются через несколько минут If ((LocalNetMask & 4) > 0) Then NodeNet = NodeNet & (((NdID.NetMask & 1) * 4) | 8) End If If ((LocalNetMask & 8) > 0) Then NodeNet = NodeNet & (((NdID.NetMask & 2) * 4) | 4) End If End If CPU_load = NdID.CPULoad Dim Alt_WS_ID As String Alt_WS_ID = CStr(RTAPLS.GetConfigurationParameter(False, "SYS_NODES", WS_ID)) If (Len(Alt_WS_ID) > 1) && (GetState(Alt_WS_ID) != _BadState) Then t_ID.text = PLStrCut(Alt_WS_ID, 25) Else t_ID.text = PLStrCut(WS_ID, 20) End If If Active Then If NdID.NodeId == LocalNDID Then rect_ID.fill = Col_Ar(2) Else rect_ID.fill = Col_Ar(14) End If Else If NdID.NodeId == LocalNDID Then rect_ID.fill = Col_Ar(14) Else rect_ID.fill = Col_Ar(8) End If End If t_Status.text = ENodeState(NStatus, False) rect_Status.fill = NodStatColor(NStatus) t_Net_1.text = IP1 t_Net_2.text = IP2 If NStatus < 4 Then rect_Net_1.fill = Col_Ar(8) rect_Net_2.fill = Col_Ar(8) t_CPU.text = "--" rect_CPU.fill = Col_Ar(8) t_DataOK.text = "--" rect_DataOK.fill = Col_Ar(8) t_Repl_S.text = "--" rect_Repl_S.fill = Col_Ar(8) t_Repl_R.text = "--" rect_Repl_R.fill = Col_Ar(8) t_Vis.text = "--" rect_Vis.fill = Col_Ar(8) Else If (IP1 == "") || ((LocalNetMask & 0xC) == 0) Then rect_Net_1.fill = Col_Ar(8) Else rect_Net_1.fill = Col_Ar((NodeNet & 4) / 4 + 1) End If If (IP2 == "") || ((LocalNetMask & 0xC) == 0) Then rect_Net_2.fill = Col_Ar(8) Else rect_Net_2.fill = Col_Ar((NodeNet & 8) / 8 + 1) End If t_CPU.text = CStr(CPU_load) If CPU_load > 90 Then rect_CPU.fill = Col_Ar(1) ElseIf CPU_load > 75 Then rect_CPU.fill = Col_Ar(3) Else rect_CPU.fill = Col_Ar(2) End If NDStatus = NdID.DataStatus If (NDStatus & RTDATA_STAT_OK) > 0 Then t_DataOK.text = "Да" rect_DataOK.fill = Col_Ar(2) Else t_DataOK.text = "Нет" rect_DataOK.fill = Col_Ar(1) End If 'задачи сделаны через флаги If (NDStatus & RTDATA_STAT_FEATURE_7_OK) Then t_Repl_S.text = "Работает" rect_Repl_S.fill = Col_Ar(2) Else t_Repl_S.text = "Не работает" rect_Repl_S.fill = Col_Ar(1) End If If (NDStatus & RTDATA_STAT_FEATURE_8_OK) Then t_Repl_R.text = "Работает" rect_Repl_R.fill = Col_Ar(2) Else t_Repl_R.text = "Не работает" rect_Repl_R.fill = Col_Ar(1) End If If (NDStatus & RTDATA_STAT_FEATURE_4_OK) Then t_Vis.text = "Работает" rect_Vis.fill = Col_Ar(2) Else t_Vis.text = "Не работает" rect_Vis.fill = Col_Ar(1) End If End If End If
End Sub
